concept_decisions: Concept pixels inspected. Retain delicate branched relief and quiet substrate, but correct its overly thick trunk and large isolated cut circle: use approximately1.8-2.2mm near-constant tunnel width and at least three branch orders, not a woody tapering tree. Connect every displayed branch logically; no disconnected circle pretending to be its section. One principal and one small independent system are one composition, not counted variants. Rounded tips, no broad lobes or pellet wall. Fine branches must remain readable from top and clay at512px. Use original integrated substrate surface with branching relief, avoiding coplanar tube/slab overlaps.
style: Original refined faceted full-volume palette-only low-poly
